states: Before (main, en-GB): the default 7-day axis read "8 Oct, 11 | 10 Oct, 05 | 11 Oct, 23" and the range line "8 Oct, 11 -> Now"; 30-day ticks sat at bucket edges near noon
After: 7d "8 Oct, 11:54 | 10 Oct, 06:00 | 12 Oct, 00:00 | 13 Oct, 18:00 | Now"; 24h ticks on the hour; 30d "15 Sept | 24 Sept | 2 Oct | 10 Oct | Now" at local midnights; all time dated with the year
No label overlap at 640px or 1280px (the chart keeps a minimum width and scrolls); US-length labels measured at the same positions keep 75px or more apart
Phone 375px shows three ticks (8 Oct, 11:55 | 12 Oct, 00:00 | Now) with no page-level horizontal overflow
A clock change that repeats an hour no longer stacks two ticks on one boundary (unit test under Europe/London)
interactions: Switched Last 24h, Last 7d, Last 30d and All time and read every visible axis label and its bounds
Resized to 640px and 375px and re-read the labels
